name: Mitsuki Momo
source:
[i]"Welcome to... Nekoneko Tourism~~~!!"[/i]

A spirited senior employee at [NekoNeko Tourism Inc.]

She’s brimming with energy, motivation, and a strong sense of duty, earning her deep trust from both coworkers and townspeople alike.

She tends to push herself too hard, though…

She's also carrying a secret she can’t reveal to anyone — when she gets extremely exhausted, cat ears and a tail pop out.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3586750]Steam[/url]]
